evidence.content: The AI co-scientist uses a generate, debate, and evolve approach to hypothesis generation.
evidence.notes: Core loop to translate into AI/LLM improvement research.

evidence.content: A supervisor coordinates specialized generation, reflection, ranking, proximity, evolution, and meta-review agents.
evidence.notes: Agent decomposition for the Code Scientist MVP.

evidence.content: The system parses a natural language research goal into a research plan configuration with preferences, constraints, and evaluation criteria.
evidence.notes: Code Scientist should persist the derived plan instead of keeping it implicit.

evidence.content: The ranking agent uses an Elo-based tournament to prioritize hypotheses, while noting that Elo is an auto-evaluation proxy.
evidence.notes: Ranking should be auditable and labeled as proxy evaluation.

evidence.content: The proximity agent builds a graph of related hypotheses to support clustering, de-duplication, diverse exploration, and tournament scheduling.
evidence.notes: Similarity edges should be stored and used when choosing pairwise matches.

evidence.content: Meta-review synthesizes recurring critique patterns and appends feedback to future agent prompts without model retraining.
evidence.notes: Self-improvement should start as externalized prompt and process feedback.

evidence.content: The supervisor periodically writes context memory containing system state, progress statistics, and feedback for later computation.
evidence.notes: Runs need restartable progress snapshots and scheduler statistics.

evidence.content: The system reviews research goals and generated hypotheses for safety and keeps comprehensive logs for auditability.
evidence.notes: Safety gates are required before ranking and reporting ideas.

evidence.content: The paper warns that literature search can miss prior work, LLMs can hallucinate, and auto-evaluation metrics need broader validation.
evidence.notes: Reports must separate generated hypotheses from verified improvements.

hypothesis.rationale: Assumption decomposition translates the paper's decomposition/debate behavior into an auditable coding-agent workflow.
assumptions: The agent can enumerate concrete assumptions before editing.
A reviewer can cheaply reject false assumptions before patching.

test_plan.experiment: Run a repo-repair benchmark with and without: Assumption audit before repo mutation.
test_plan.success_condition: Candidate reduces regressions without unacceptable wall-time or cost increase.

evidence.notes: Core loop to translate into AI/LLM improvement research.

evidence.content: A supervisor coordinates specialized generation, reflection, ranking, proximity, evolution, and meta-review agents.
evidence.notes: Agent decomposition for the Code Scientist MVP.

evidence.content: The system parses a natural language research goal into a research plan configuration with preferences, constraints, and evaluation criteria.
evidence.notes: Code Scientist should persist the derived plan instead of keeping it implicit.

evidence.content: The ranking agent uses an Elo-based tournament to prioritize hypotheses, while noting that Elo is an auto-evaluation proxy.
evidence.notes: Ranking should be auditable and labeled as proxy evaluation.

evidence.content: The proximity agent builds a graph of related hypotheses to support clustering, de-duplication, diverse exploration, and tournament scheduling.
evidence.notes: Similarity edges should be stored and used when choosing pairwise matches.

evidence.notes: Self-improvement should start as externalized prompt and process feedback.

evidence.notes: Reports must separate generated hypotheses from verified improvements.

hypothesis.title: Critic-before-edit assumption decomposition
hypothesis.claim: A critic-before-edit loop that decomposes assumptions before patching will reduce bad repo-level fixes.
hypothesis.rationale: False premises about call paths, invariants, and test scope are common causes of bad edits. Targets unexplored area relative to 0 existing hypotheses.
assumptions: The agent can state assumptions before editing.
A critic can catch false premises cheaply.

test_plan.experiment: Compare baseline coding-agent workflow against: Critic-before-edit assumption decomposition.
test_plan.success_condition: Candidate improves pass rate or regression count without unacceptable cost increase.
